content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-53. - Prior agreements.
content.summary:
The city will honor all approvals prior to February 19, 1979, for out-of-city water
               or sewer service that may be in conflict with any provision of this division.
(Code 1981, § 33-23; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
